text: **The grammar REFUSES rather than skips.** The parser accepts exactly `<SIGIL>:<ID>` with sigil in `STEELTHREAD | ISSUE` and an optional trailing comment. For every rejected input the run exits non-zero AND the offending line number appears in the output. No input is silently skipped -- a skipped line drops an artefact from realisation and leaves an estate indistinguishable from one that never listed it.
